item.title: State Department orders nonprofit libraries to stop processing passport applications
item.description: Pennsylvania Reps. Madeleine Dean and John Joyce have proposed bipartisan legislation that would allow nonprofit public libraries to continue to serve as passport acceptance.

item.title: ‘Setting them up for failure’: Wilmington community members vow to fight closure of long-standing prison jobs program
